title: VISKAFORS loveseat
description: VISKAFORS loveseat, Lejde gray/green/brown VISKAFORS is a sofa that becomes a statement piece in the room. The classic design has generous, inviting shapes – and when you sink into the deep soft seat, the sofa gives you an embracing feel.
materialAndCare: Clip: Polypropylene; Fabric: 71 % cotton, 21 % polyester (100% recycled), 8 % viscose/rayon; Frame: Solid wood, Laminated veneer lumber, Plywood, Particleboard, Fiberboard, Polyurethane foam 1.5 lb/cu.ft., Polyurethane foam 1.5 lb/cu.ft., Polyurethane foam 2.0 lb/cu.ft., High-resilience polyurethane foam (cold foam) 2.2 lb/cu.ft.; Solid birch, Tinted lacquer
